arguments.summary: A Cobalt Strike beacon was detected on endpoint 10.0.6.88, originating from a malicious UPX-packed executable. The malware established C2 communication with 198.51.100.23 and used DNS tunneling via data-exfil.evil.com. Investigation revealed lateral movement from compromised host 10.0.5.42 (WS-FIN-042), which had been previously beaconing to the same C2 infrastructure. The threat actor attempted Kerberos TGT requests and SMB-based lateral movement. Immediate containment actions included blocking C2 IPs at the firewall, resetting credentials for CORP\auser, and deploying a cleanup playbook to remove persistence mechanisms and injected payloads.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_UPX_Packed {
    meta:
        description = "Detects UPX-packed Cobalt Strike beacons with common entropy and section names"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001, T1027"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $upx = "UPX!" ascii
        $section1 = ".rsrc" ascii
        $section2 = "ntdll" ascii
        $beacon_mutex = "MSCTF.Asm.{" ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $upx and $section1 and $section2 and $beacon_mutex
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration in Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/001/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2E 72 63 64 2E 63 6F 6D } // ".rcd.com" - common C2 domain artifact
        $b = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" fullword ascii
        $c = { 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 [4] 00 00 00 00 } // config struct pattern
    condition:
        all of them
}
